listing.name: Import Tuner Challenge — ITC-Recomp (Spooky098529)
listing.summary: The game uses 30 Hz logic with frame interpolation and slows when the host cannot keep up. The rexglue-removal-project branch continues this implementation; it is not a separate port. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 default.xex and complete disc files. The exact edition, media ID and hash are not confirmed here; check upstream’s manifest before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the source-build instructions with ReXGlue and Vulkan 1.3 on an x64 CPU with SSE4.2. Upstream testing covers Linux on Steam Deck and an RX 7900 XT; Windows support is experimental.

warnings: The game uses 30 Hz logic with frame interpolation and slows when the host cannot keep up. The rexglue-removal-project branch continues this implementation; it is not a separate port.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
